name: Chalk Strength Club
tagline: A coached strength gym. Small classes, real programming, and a coach who knows your numbers.
trial_note: Your first week is free — no card needed, nothing to sign.
hours_note: Staffed hours. Members with a key fob train 24/7.

stats.label: racks on a 9,000 sq ft floor

first_steps.title: Say hello at the desk
first_steps.body: Your coach meets you at the door, shows you the lockers, and asks what you want out of the next six months.

first_steps.title: Move, don't max
first_steps.body: A short movement screen — squat, hinge, push, pull. No testing, no numbers on a whiteboard, nobody watching.

first_steps.title: Join the class
first_steps.body: You train alongside the group with your own weights, scaled by a coach who has seen every version of your first day.

first_steps.title: Leave with a plan
first_steps.body: Your coach writes down your starting numbers and the three classes that suit your week. Come back tomorrow, or don't — no pressure.

faqs.question: I've never lifted. Is this for me?
faqs.answer: Most of our members started exactly there. Every class is scaled person by person, and your first week is coached one step at a time.

faqs.question: Do I need to book classes?
faqs.answer: Yes — classes cap at twelve so a coach can watch every rep. Book in the member app up to seven days ahead; drop-ins can call the desk.

faqs.question: What should I bring?
faqs.answer: Flat shoes, water, and something you can squat in. We have chalk, belts, lockers and showers.

faqs.question: Can I freeze my membership?
faqs.answer: Any time, for up to three months a year, for travel, injury or a new baby. Just tell the desk.

art_direction.identity: A coached strength gym after dark: rubber-floor graphite walls, chalk-white type, hairline rules, square corners, one chalk-white band, and bright daylight photography. Reads like a training log on the gym wall, not a nightclub — no neon, no glow, no gradients.
art_direction.type: Sofia Sans Extra Condensed (800–900, uppercase) for headings, numbers and tracked labels; Rethink Sans for everything else. No third family.
art_direction.color: One accent: plate red (bg-primary) for the Start a free trial button, the 'Today' marker and the highlighted plan — never as text. The bumper-plate colors (red, blue, yellow, green, white) are data: each program's plate field colors its chip and its classes on the timetable. Never use them as decoration.
art_direction.signature: The timetable board: the whole week as a real table, times down the side and days across, every class edged in its program's plate color, today's column lit. It reads straight from the sessions and programs collections — keep it wherever the design evolves.
art_direction.voice: A good coach: dry, specific, encouraging without cheerleading. Numbers over adjectives. No 'beast mode', no 'crush it', no exclamation points.
